programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: The Queen of chocolate returns for another season of dessert wonders! Kirsten kicks things off with her exceptional chocolate toffee éclairs, unveils the secret to crafting a flawless blondie cheesecake and wows us with a delicate white chocolate creation infused with a hint of tropical flavour.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Dive into today's episode as Kirsten presents a decadent chocolate date & meringue cake, luxuriously rich and moist. Continue the journey with Kirsten's soft and fluffy marshmallow wheels, and experience the magic of an extraordinary crème caramel that melts in your mouth.

programme.title: Karena & Kasey's Foreign Flavours
programme.desc: In Taipei, Kasey and Karena find a food lovers paradise filled with great flavours and an abundance of restaurants. No wonder the culinary philosophy here is eat often and eat well! They also travel to the Hualian region to learn more about the food of the Indigenous peoples of Taiwan.

programme.title: Karena & Kasey's Foreign Flavours
programme.desc: In Arizona, Karena and Kasey meet Nephi Craig, a ground-breaking and inspiring Native American chef. Nephi cooks not only for the food, but also as a way to connect with cultural traditions and to fortify the local community.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today’s Come Dine With Me: The Professionals travels to Oxfordshire and kicking off the competition is The Snooty Mehmaan in Faringdon with owner Asad and Executive chef Rehan hoping to bag the grand.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Diana explores the balance of salty, sweet and sour flavours that is fundamental in Thai cuisine. Chef Adam D’Sylva perfects this harmony of flavours with a refreshing dish, ‘Seared Tuna with Nahm Jim.’ Diana cooks a popular Thai dish ‘Beef Massaman Curry.’ Jacob Leung (cook and author) prepares a fragrant and smokey ‘Thai Beef Salad- Nam Tok with Sticky Rice Powder.’

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Diana delves into the vibrant and healthy flavours of Vietnamese cooking. With her flatmate Khanh Ong they create ‘Cha Gio Re’- a kind of spring roll with a lace-like exterior. Diana shares ‘Banh Beo’- delicate, steamed rice cakes that are sure to impress. Jerry Mai (chef), also joins Diana to demonstrate how easy it is to make your own rice noodles at home .

programme.title: Anna and Kristina's Grocery Bag
programme.desc: What's the equation for kitchen success? Anna and Kristina tackle a heady cookbook that uses mathematical combinations to perfect food...and there's no tutor to help them.

programme.title: Anna and Kristina's Grocery Bag
programme.desc: Anna and Kristina hit the slopes for a wintery Whistler trip that has them whipping up a warm apresski feast. But will their menu go downhill?

programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.desc: Italian home cooks learn from a young age that resourcefulness in the kitchen can save the day, and the bank. The art of breathing fresh new life into leftovers is one of the most valuable things Silvia's mother ever taught me in the kitchen. To prove it, after she cooks beautiful zucchini pasta... Silvia and her mother (via Facetime) take the leftovers and completely reinvent them as a delicious homemade Spaghetti Frittata.

programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.desc: Once a year Silvia's friend Michael and his whole family come together for one of their most cherished family food rituals, Salami Day. In this episode Silvia has been invited to the family gathering to lend a hand and learn how true homemade Italian sausages and salamis are crafted and about how important the tradition is to Michael's whole family. Wait until you see the pasta they make!

programme.title: Wall of Chefs
programme.desc: A bitter ingredient in Chef Dale Mackay’s fridge leaves the home cooks in a quandary and they are then charged with making a restaurant-worthy dessert inspired by Chef Guy Rawlings’ peanut frozen custard.

programme.title: Bake With Anna Olson
programme.desc: Chef Anna Olson dives into the delicious world of savoury pastries. She bakes up Greek spanakopita, Argentine beef empanadas and Croatian cheese burek.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Jenn discovers how vital yeast is in everything from beer and wine to sourdough bread and pizza dough.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today we’re in and around Birmingham, kicking off at Island Lounge, where married chefs Marlon and Dania, are showcasing their Caribbean cuisine. programme.title: Ainsley's Food We Love
programme.desc: Ainsley is in his kitchen inspired by dishes for those special occasions – date nights, anniversaries, dinner parties and festivals. Ainsley starts his special menu with a Chorizo Crusted Hake on Boulangere Potatoes with Salad. Food Writer and baking enthusiast, Alex Hollywood shows Ainsley her twist on a classic dinner party favourite – Pineapple & Cinnamon Tarte Tatin. - Sabrina Ghayour is in her kitchen showing Ainsley a dish fit for any special occasion with her Marinated Steak & Pul Biber Butter. Ainsley is back in his kitchen sharing his decadent Orange Mocha Mousse with Cardamom and finishing off the menu with a classic Chicken Cordon Bleu, with Cannellini Mash & Cherry Tomatoes.

programme.title: Bake With Anna Olson
programme.desc: Chef Anna Olson shows how to turn a bar or square into an elegant plated dessert and she bakes up three different and delicious styles.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Jenn joins the wild rice harvest in Northwest Saskatchewan before sharing a meal that uses the ingredient in creative ways

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today we’re in and around Birmingham and Wolverhampton and first up is Adian’s Dining where chef Adian and fiance and front of house manager Eloise are showcasing their Caribbean/ Asian fusion menu. However they quickly discover that fellow foodies Kieran and Brandy from Smoking Bagels are vocal about what they do and don’t like leaving Fiona and Simon of Rodeos nervous about what’s to come.

programme.title: Hot Mess Express
programme.sub-title: Brennan storms the kitchen - chef Lauren
programme.desc: Energetic Brennen will try to beat a restaurant chef and make a better version of a fun take on a southen classic. All that with the help of pro-chef Lauren. Is he up for the task?
